speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) how is the trend among foreign students applying for Permanent Residency in the last 10 years; (b) what is the percentage of success; (c) how many stayed on and continued to work in Singapore and subsequently take on citizenship.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Can the Second Ministeer share in terms of the nationalities of the students who have been successful and have taken up citizenship?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Can I ask Mr Saktiandi to repeat his question?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: By and large, unless my memory serves me wrong, I think a good majority of them come from Asia.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: These considerations apply to all applicants, including the foreign students.

speaker: Mr Speaker
